sourceProfile.shape_origin: declared example; statically inferred, not observed
sourceProfile.drawing_scope: manual_bn calling fused_bn; gain/bias supplied by caller, no running-statistics module.

sourceFacts: Statistics are accumulated in float32, then mean and variance are cast to the original dtype.
The source uses E[x²]-E[x]² without clamping. Both moment reductions read the same input; their glyph is a compound statistics operation.
gain and bias are input arguments, not parameters declared by these functions.
sourceSemantics: recorded graph projection; imported SVG glyphs; source model not executed
